oneOf.title: disable
oneOf.description: Disables encryption of communication between BigHammer and source database.

oneOf.title: allow
oneOf.description: Enables encryption only when required by the source database.

oneOf.title: prefer
oneOf.description: Allows unencrypted connection only if the source database does not support encryption.

oneOf.title: require
oneOf.description: Always require encryption. If the source database server does not support encryption, connection will fail.

oneOf.title: verify-ca
oneOf.description: Always require encryption and verifies that the source database server has a valid SSL certificate.

client_key_password.title: Client key password
client_key_password.description: Password for keystorage. If you do not add it - the password will be generated automatically.

oneOf.title: verify-full
oneOf.description: This is the most secure mode. Always require encryption and verifies the identity of the source database server.

client_key_password.description: Password for keystorage. If you do not add it - the password will be generated automatically.

replication_method.title: Update Method
replication_method.description: Configures how data is extracted from the database.

oneOf.title: Read Changes using Write-Ahead Log (CDC)
oneOf.description: Recommended - Incrementally reads new inserts, updates, and deletes using the Postgres. This needs to be configured on the source database itself. Recommended for tables of any size.

plugin.title: Plugin
plugin.description: A logical decoding plugin installed on the PostgreSQL server.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: A Postgres publication used for consuming changes.

initial_waiting_seconds.title: Initial Waiting Time in Seconds (Advanced)
initial_waiting_seconds.description: The amount of time the connector will wait when it launches to determine if there is new data to sync or not. Defaults to 1200 seconds. Valid range: 120 seconds to 2400 seconds.

queue_size.title: Size of the queue (Advanced)
queue_size.description: The size of the internal queue. This may interfere with memory consumption and efficiency of the connector, please be careful.

lsn_commit_behaviour.title: LSN commit behaviour
lsn_commit_behaviour.description: Determines when BigHammer should flush the LSN of processed WAL logs in the source database. `After loading Data in the destination` is default. If `While reading Data` is selected, in case of a downstream failure (while loading data into the destination), next sync would result in a full sync.
enum: After loading Data in the destination
lsn_commit_behaviour.default: After loading Data in the destination

heartbeat_action_query.title: Debezium heartbeat query (Advanced)
heartbeat_action_query.description: Specifies a query that the connector executes on the source database when the connector sends a heartbeat message.

invalid_cdc_cursor_position_behavior.title: Invalid CDC position behavior (Advanced)
invalid_cdc_cursor_position_behavior.description: Determines whether BigHammer should fail or re-sync data in case of an stale/invalid cursor value into the WAL. If 'Fail sync' is chosen, a user will have to manually reset the connection before being able to continue syncing data. If 'Re-sync data' is chosen, BigHammer will automatically trigger a refresh but could lead to higher cloud costs and data loss.

initial_load_timeout_hours.title: Initial Load Timeout in Hours (Advanced)
initial_load_timeout_hours.description: The amount of time an initial load is allowed to continue for before catching up on CDC logs.

oneOf.title: Detect Changes with Xmin System Column
oneOf.description: Recommended - Incrementally reads new inserts and updates via Postgres Xmin system column. Suitable for databases that have low transaction pressure.

oneOf.title: Scan Changes with User Defined Cursor
oneOf.description: Incrementally detects new inserts and updates using the cursor column chosen when configuring a connection (e.g. created_at, updated_at).

select_columns.description: List of column names to select from the dataset

drop_columns.description: List of column names to drop from the dataset

rename_columns.description: Mapping of old column names to new column names

sep.description: Sets a separator for each field and value. This separator can be one or more characters.

encoding.description: Sets the encoding to be used for CSV files.

quote.description: Sets a single character used for escaping quoted values where the separator can be part of the value.

escape.description: Sets a single character used for escaping quotes inside an already quoted value.

comment.description: Sets a single character used for skipping lines beginning with this character. By default, it is disabled.

header.description: Uses the first line of the CSV file as the names of the columns.

inferSchema.description: Infers the input schema automatically from data. It requires one extra pass over the data. CSV built-in functions ignore this option.

preferDate.description: During schema inference (inferSchema), attempts to infer string columns that contain dates as Date if the values satisfy the dateFormat option or default date format. For columns that contain a mixture of dates and timestamps, try inferring them as TimestampType if timestamp format not specified, otherwise infer them as StringType.

enforceSchema.description: If it is set to true, the specified or inferred schema will be forcibly applied to datasource files, and headers in CSV files will be ignored. If the option is set to false, the schema will be validated against all headers in CSV files in the case when the header option is set to true. Field names in the schema and column names in CSV headers are checked by their positions taking into account spark.sql.caseSensitive. Though the default value is true, it is recommended to disable the enforceSchema option to avoid incorrect results. CSV built-in functions ignore this option.

ignoreLeadingWhiteSpace.description: Ignores leading whitespaces in CSV fields. By default, it is false.

ignoreTrailingWhiteSpace.description: Ignores trailing whitespaces in CSV fields. By default, it is false.

nullValue.description: Sets the string representation of a null value. By default, it is empty string.

nanValue.description: Sets the string representation of a non-number value. By default, it is 'NaN'.

positiveInf.description: Sets the string representation of a positive infinity value. By default, it is 'Inf'.

negativeInf.description: Sets the string representation of a negative infinity value. By default, it is '-Inf'.

dateFormat.description: Sets the string that indicates a date format. Custom date formats follow the formats at `java.text.SimpleDateFormat`. This applies to both date type and timestamp type.

timestampFormat.description: Sets the string that indicates a timestamp format. Custom date formats follow the formats at `java.text.SimpleDateFormat`. This applies to both date type and timestamp type.

timestampNTZFormat.description: Sets the string that indicates a timestamp format for TIMESTAMP_NTZ type. Custom date formats follow the formats at `java.text.SimpleDateFormat`. This applies to both date type and timestamp type.

mode.description: Specifies the behavior when parsing malformed records. It can be PERMISSIVE, DROPMALFORMED, or FAILFAST. mode=PERMISSIVE is the default mode, which sets other fields to null when it meets a corrupted record and puts the malformed string into a new field configured by columnNameOfCorruptRecord. mode=DROPMALFORMED ignores the whole corrupted record. mode=FAILFAST throws an exception when it meets corrupted records.

columnNameOfCorruptRecord.description: Sets the name of a field in which the malformed string is stored. When set to an empty string, it puts malformed strings into an automatically generated field named _corrupt_record.

multiLine.description: Parse one record, which may span multiple lines, per file.

emptyValue.description: Sets the string representation of an empty value. By default, it is empty string.

locale.description: Sets the locale of the data when reading CSV files. Refer IETF BCP 47 for language tags.

lineSep.description: Sets the line separator for CSV files.

unescapedQuoteHandling.description: Sets the mode for handling unescaped quotes inside CSV fields. By default, it is set to STOP_AT_DELIMITER.Allowed values are STOP_AT_DELIMITER, BACK_TO_DELIMITER, and BACK_TO_CLOSEST_QUOTE. Please refer https://spark.apache.org/docs/3.4.0/sql-data-sources-csv.html for more details.

select_columns.description: List of column names to select from the dataset

drop_columns.description: List of column names to drop from the dataset

rename_columns.description: Mapping of old column names to new column names

join_input.description: The name of input dataframe to join

operation_type.description: The type of set operation to perform.

allow_missing_columns.description: Whether to allow missing columns in the input datasets. Only applicable for 'Union By Name'.

dependent_on.description: List of transformations this transformation depends on.

lookup_type.description: The type of lookup to perform.

lookup_config.description: Configuration for reading the lookup data (only for Column Based lookup).

name.description: The name of the lookup configuration.

source.description: Reference to the source of the lookup data.

read_options.description: Options for reading the lookup data.

header.description: Whether the lookup data has a header row.

lookup_data.description: Literal data for lookup (only for Literal lookup).

lookup_conditions.description: Conditions for joining the main DataFrame with the lookup DataFrame.

oneOf.description: Conditions for Column Based lookup.

column_name.description: The column in the main DataFrame to join on.

lookup_with.description: The column in the lookup DataFrame to join with.

oneOf.description: Condition for Literal lookup.

oneOf.title: disable
oneOf.description: Disables encryption of communication between BigHammer and source database.

oneOf.title: allow
oneOf.description: Enables encryption only when required by the source database.

oneOf.title: prefer
oneOf.description: Allows unencrypted connection only if the source database does not support encryption.

oneOf.title: require
oneOf.description: Always require encryption. If the source database server does not support encryption, connection will fail.

oneOf.title: verify-ca
oneOf.description: Always require encryption and verifies that the source database server has a valid SSL certificate.

client_key_password.title: Client key password
client_key_password.description: Password for keystorage. If you do not add it - the password will be generated automatically.

oneOf.title: verify-full
oneOf.description: This is the most secure mode. Always require encryption and verifies the identity of the source database server.

client_key_password.title: Client key password
client_key_password.description: Password for keystorage. If you do not add it - the password will be generated automatically.

replication_method.title: Update Method
replication_method.description: Configures how data is extracted from the database.

oneOf.title: Read Changes using Write-Ahead Log (CDC)
oneOf.description: Recommended - Incrementally reads new inserts, updates, and deletes using the Postgres. This needs to be configured on the source database itself. Recommended for tables of any size.

plugin.title: Plugin
plugin.description: A logical decoding plugin installed on the PostgreSQL server.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: A Postgres publication used for consuming changes.

initial_waiting_seconds.title: Initial Waiting Time in Seconds (Advanced)
initial_waiting_seconds.description: The amount of time the connector will wait when it launches to determine if there is new data to sync or not. Defaults to 1200 seconds. Valid range: 120 seconds to 2400 seconds.

queue_size.title: Size of the queue (Advanced)
queue_size.description: The size of the internal queue. This may interfere with memory consumption and efficiency of the connector, please be careful.

lsn_commit_behaviour.title: LSN commit behaviour
lsn_commit_behaviour.description: Determines when BigHammer should flush the LSN of processed WAL logs in the source database. `After loading Data in the destination` is default. If `While reading Data` is selected, in case of a downstream failure (while loading data into the destination), next sync would result in a full sync.
enum: After loading Data in the destination
lsn_commit_behaviour.default: After loading Data in the destination

heartbeat_action_query.title: Debezium heartbeat query (Advanced)
heartbeat_action_query.description: Specifies a query that the connector executes on the source database when the connector sends a heartbeat message.

invalid_cdc_cursor_position_behavior.title: Invalid CDC position behavior (Advanced)
invalid_cdc_cursor_position_behavior.description: Determines whether BigHammer should fail or re-sync data in case of an stale/invalid cursor value into the WAL. If 'Fail sync' is chosen, a user will have to manually reset the connection before being able to continue syncing data. If 'Re-sync data' is chosen, BigHammer will automatically trigger a refresh but could lead to higher cloud costs and data loss.

initial_load_timeout_hours.title: Initial Load Timeout in Hours (Advanced)
initial_load_timeout_hours.description: The amount of time an initial load is allowed to continue for before catching up on CDC logs.

oneOf.title: Detect Changes with Xmin System Column
oneOf.description: Recommended - Incrementally reads new inserts and updates via Postgres Xmin system column. Suitable for databases that have low transaction pressure.

oneOf.title: Scan Changes with User Defined Cursor
oneOf.description: Incrementally detects new inserts and updates using the cursor column chosen when configuring a connection (e.g. created_at, updated_at).

inferSchema.description: Infers the input schema automatically from data. It requires one extra pass over the data. CSV built-in functions ignore this option.

preferDate.description: During schema inference (inferSchema), attempts to infer string columns that contain dates as Date if the values satisfy the dateFormat option or default date format. For columns that contain a mixture of dates and timestamps, try inferring them as TimestampType if timestamp format not specified, otherwise infer them as StringType.

enforceSchema.description: If it is set to true, the specified or inferred schema will be forcibly applied to datasource files, and headers in CSV files will be ignored. If the option is set to false, the schema will be validated against all headers in CSV files in the case when the header option is set to true. Field names in the schema and column names in CSV headers are checked by their positions taking into account spark.sql.caseSensitive. Though the default value is true, it is recommended to disable the enforceSchema option to avoid incorrect results. CSV built-in functions ignore this option.

mode.description: Specifies the behavior when parsing malformed records. It can be PERMISSIVE, DROPMALFORMED, or FAILFAST. mode=PERMISSIVE is the default mode, which sets other fields to null when it meets a corrupted record and puts the malformed string into a new field configured by columnNameOfCorruptRecord. mode=DROPMALFORMED ignores the whole corrupted record. mode=FAILFAST throws an exception when it meets corrupted records.

columnNameOfCorruptRecord.description: Sets the name of a field in which the malformed string is stored. When set to an empty string, it puts malformed strings into an automatically generated field named _corrupt_record.
